system.description:
Draws aside the veils of space and time to grant knowledge. Each Divination Work is learned with a Method (Gazing, Hieroscopy, Omens, Oneiromancy & Trances, Somatomancy, Sortilege). Learning a new Method takes three months. Successful divinations grant Insights and Insight Dice (p. 97).

Sword Chronicle p. 95. A Sorcerous Benefit (Blood of the Sorcerers, Blood of the Far Isles, Natural Sorcerer or Sorcerous Initiation) grants access.
system.tools: Whatever the Method needs: mirrors, flames, bones, cards, entrails or nothing at all.
system.initiation: Add your Knowledge rank to all Awareness test totals.
system.resonances: The Method's medium, and something belonging to the subject.
